boundary_mechanism_reference: Evidence is delimited by deterministic collision-safe boundaries defined in rag_context_contract_v1.json (evidence_boundaries). Citation semantics are unchanged by that mechanism.

citation_mode_rules.document_section: Cite document + section_path/heading. Page metadata, if present, is retained as supplemental_source_location and the mode is NOT rewritten to pdf_page.
citation_mode_rules.image: Cite document/source provenance. No fabricated figure or page numbering. A real page anchor may be supplemental.
citation_mode_rules.pdf_page: Cite document + page range from original_page_start/end. If the page anchor is missing, citation_quality=degraded and no page is invented.
citation_mode_rules.slide: Cite document + slide range from slide_start/end. Never substitute a page number because the underlying file is a PDF/PPT derivative. Missing slide anchor -> degraded.
citation_mode_rules.source_only: Cite the SOURCE. This does NOT imply page metadata is absent: 50 of 71 such chunks carry source-derived pages, which are retained as supplemental_source_location only.
citation_mode_rules.table_or_sheet: Cite document + heading/section identity. Never flattened into a page reference. contains_table preserved.

citation_quality.degraded: an anchored mode declared its anchor but the anchor is missing or invalid
citation_quality.exact: anchored mode with a valid matching anchor (page or slide)

core_rule: citation_mode and provenance_status are INDEPENDENT fields and must never be conflated or inferred from one another.
llm_contract: The generation model cites by evidence_id only (e.g. [E003]). It never decides document, page or slide; those coordinates are precomputed here from frozen payload metadata.
no_fabrication_guarantees: No page number is invented; page fields are emitted only when the payload carries them AND provenance permits.
Ranges are validated (start<=end, start>=1); invalid ranges become degraded and are never repaired.
Chunk text is passed through byte-for-byte: never summarised, translated, paraphrased or truncated.
precedence: provenance_status == source_only overrides the citation_mode's preferred anchor: the citation degrades to source level and no coordinate is emitted.

provenance_status_rules.page_resolved: A page anchor exists and may be cited.
provenance_status_rules.section_resolved: A section anchor exists; cite section.
provenance_status_rules.slide_resolved: A slide anchor exists and may be cited.
provenance_status_rules.source_only: NO resolvable anchor at all. Verified across all 539 such chunks: page and slide fields are null. This layer must never emit a page or slide for them, whatever the citation_mode says.
